Employee.title: My tenders
Employee.intro: Prepare a draft and follow its status through publication.

Manage.title: Manage tenders
Manage.intro: Review drafts, prepare supplier forms, and publish tenders.
Manage.loadFailed: The tender could not be loaded.
Manage.notFound: This tender is not available to your account.
Manage.scoringHint: Weights must total 100. Scores and weights must be between 0 and 100. They lock at publication.
